answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47193 Country: India Title: Dua Question: Please tell me whether the dua "Bisaume GHadin Nawaitu Min Shahre Ramadan" for the intention of sehri is lawful or not. If not, please give an alternate dua. Answer ID: 47193 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1213/1212/M=10/1434) Niyah means the intention of heart and one eats sehri with the intention of fasting. Then eating sehri is tantamount to intention. There is no need of intention in words separately but if one reads the said dua in sehri then it is lawful and better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
